snippet.title: Dry Hard: Laundry Simulator - Run a Cozy Dry Cleaner - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3936190/Dry_Hard_Laundry_Simulator/
